scope: Operational monitoring, audited maintenance control/status, snapshot expiry/assignment gates and their legacy catchall exclusions only; prototype, not a whole-application security certification
summary: Verified identity, ownership, explicit opt-in, bounded allowlisted records, append-only events and administrator-only raw diagnostics are enforced. Maintenance policy requires immutable matching audits; status is server-write-only. A bounded leased worker, transactionally consent-checked manual saves and current-consent removal are prepared, not deployed. Production verification and activation remain separate prerequisites.

findings.issue: Activity is client-reported and can be forged or omitted; no backend verification or rate budget exists.
findings.recommendation: Use these signals only for support and optional engagement context, never grading or discipline. Add trusted ingestion and abuse controls before scale.

findings.issue: Expiry timestamps are not deletion. Prepared cleanup is capped and can leave backlog; the consent handler is asynchronous and has no effect until deployed. Preferences and latest snapshots are separate retention records.
findings.recommendation: Review and explicitly approve backend activation, validate billing/capacity and school retention policy, monitor backlog and removal failures, and use approved TTL or manual cleanup where required. Maintain an account-erasure procedure.

findings.issue: Legacy academic staff reads remain broad and the current staff email mapping supports only the existing instructor; UI section filters are not multi-tenant academic authorization.
findings.recommendation: Migrate staff roles and class assignments in a separately reviewed backend change before adding instructors or claiming cross-teacher academic isolation.

findings.issue: Manual administrators still control coarse projection rows and roster values. The worker verifies current Auth ownership, consent and sections, but event content remains self-reported and cross-service Auth changes cannot be atomic with Firestore publication.
findings.recommendation: Keep summaries non-grading, bounded and visibly attributed. Review Admin SDK IAM and monitoring-only mutation paths; validate production event delivery and failure recovery before activation.
